relevance.rationale: INFRA: file absent from HEAD and the working tree; exists only on origin/claude/upload-bib-papers-2026-05-19 (intake commit 720a96221d). Recovered from git history. Identity confirmed from the document's own header (Algebraic & Geometric Topology 6 (2006) 1113-1214, bottom tangles and universal invariants, single author) and matches the seeded key's title. THREE of the FOUR citation sites are miscitations of this key, and the corpus already knows why: folio/schema/references.ts:2138 records that key habiro2004cyclotomic was added on 2026-06-07 precisely to 'untangle the overloaded [habiro2002] key: most QOU citers intended this ring-definition paper, not Bottom tangles (habiro2002) or colored Jones of simple links (habiro2000)' — but the citation sites were never migrated. Evidence from full-text grep of the recovered PDF: 'colored Jones' 0 hits; 'cyclotomic' 1 hit, and that hit is in the BIBLIOGRAPHY (entry [24], pointing at the separate cyclotomic-completions paper). So this document contains no colored-Jones content and no cyclotomic-completion theorem. Site-by-site: (1) folio/quantum-observable-universe/mass-theory/residue-at-root-proof.md:20 cites [habiro2002] for 'the Habiro ring's cyclotomic projection pi_n is a Z-algebra map for each n', and :28 for 'the Habiro-completion theorem' — both belong to habiro2004cyclotomic; this is a LOAD-BEARING miscitation inside a proof block. (2) folio/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/MassTheory/HabiroMagnitudeA3.lean:61 writes `-- Ref: [habiro2002] K. Habiro, On the colored Jones polynomials of some simple links, Surikaisekikenkyusho Kokyuroku 1172 (2000) 34-43` — the key/gloss mismatch is explicit in the line itself; that gloss is the registered key habiro2000 (references.ts:6922). (3) folio/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/BraidKnot/HabiroNewtonLadder.lean:59 cites [habiro2002] for the Habiro-Le double-Pochhammer colored-Jones formula 'which the literature proves' — again not this document; note the same file already cites habiro2004cyclotomic CORRECTLY at line 18, so the two Ref lines in one file disagree. (4) folio/quantum-observable-universe/lean/QOU/BraidKnot/BraidLinkTypes.lean:166 is the only CORRECT site. Verdict supporting: the bottom-tangle/universal-invariant machinery is real background for the folio's braid-closure picture, but only one corpus site actually uses it.

keyResults.statement: A finite generating set for the subcategory B of framed oriented tangles acting on bottom tangles, and a braided functor J from B to Mod_H for a ribbon Hopf algebra H, giving an algebraic handle on the range of quantum link invariants.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is what BraidLinkTypes.lean:166 legitimately leans on (braid/tangle closure types); it is the only claim in the corpus this document actually supports.

proposedActions.rationale: residue-at-root-proof.md:20 and :28 attribute the cyclotomic projection pi_n and the Habiro-completion theorem to this document, which contains neither; the registered key for those statements is habiro2004cyclotomic (references.ts:2127). This is the load-bearing one — it sits inside a proof block.

HabiroNewtonLadder.lean:59 cites [habiro2002] for the Habiro-Le colored-Jones double-Pochhammer formula; the same file already cites habiro2004cyclotomic correctly at line 18. Align line 59 with line 18.

HabiroMagnitudeA3.lean:61 uses key [habiro2002] while its own gloss names the colored-Jones-of-simple-links work, which is registered as habiro2000 (references.ts:6922). Dangling key variant — the gloss and the key denote different items.
